description: This file defines a shared informer factory for Kubernetes API resources, including configuration options, lifecycle management, and cache synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: sharedInformerFactory
classes.description: Implements the SharedInformerFactory interface, managing informers, lifecycle, and cache synchronization.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts all informers in separate goroutines, handling shutdown gracefully.

methods.name: StartWithContext
methods.description: Starts all informers with a provided context, allowing cancellation.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Marks the factory as shutting down and waits for all goroutines to terminate.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSync
methods.description: Blocks until all started informers' caches are synchronized or the stop channel is closed.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSyncWithContext
methods.description: Blocks until all started informers' caches are synchronized or the context is canceled.

methods.name: InformerFor
methods.description: Returns a shared informer for a given runtime object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Cr
methods.description: Returns a cr.Interface for managing custom resource informers.
